subtitle: Compare grocery deals
shortDescription: Track grocery prices, compare stores, and watch for better deals.
promotionalText: Find better grocery prices before you shop.
fullDescription: PocketCart helps shoppers compare grocery prices, save products to a watchlist, and spot better deals across nearby stores. Search products, review price history, check store prices, and use alerts to decide when a deal is worth buying. The app is designed for practical grocery planning without ad tracking or data resale.
reviewNotes: PocketCart can be reviewed with a new email/password account from More. Account deletion is available inside More and on the web at https://pocketcart.app/delete-account. Location permission is optional and is only used when a reviewer chooses map-based store discovery.
